segments.sn22.86:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
segments.sn22.86:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā anurādho bhagavato avidūre araññakuṭikāyaṃ viharati.
segments.sn22.86:1.3: Atha kho sambahulā aññatitthiyā paribbājakā yena āyasmā anurādho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā anurādhena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
segments.sn22.86:1.4: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn22.86:1.5: “yo so, āvuso anurādha, tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto, taṃ tathāgato imesu catūsu ṭhānesu paññāpayamāno paññāpeti –
segments.sn22.86:1.6: ‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vā,‘na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vā,‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vā,‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vā”ti?
segments.sn22.86:2.1: Evaṃ vutte, āyasmā anurādho te aññatitthiye paribbājake etadavoca –
segments.sn22.86:2.2: “yo so āvuso tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato aññatra imehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññāpeti –
segments.sn22.86:2.3: ‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vā,‘na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vā,‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vā,‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vā”ti.
segments.sn22.86:2.4: Evaṃ vutte, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn22.86:2.5: “so cāyaṃ bhikkhu navo bhavissati acirapabbajito, thero vā pana bālo abyatto”ti.
segments.sn22.86:2.6: Atha kho aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ navavādena ca bālavādena ca apasādetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.
segments.sn22.86:3.1: Atha kho āyasmato anurādhassa acirapakkantesu tesu aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu etadahosi –
segments.sn22.86:3.2: “sace kho maṃ te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā uttariṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyuṃ.
segments.sn22.86:3.3: Kathaṃ byākaramāno nu khvāhaṃ tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ vuttavādī ceva bhagavato assaṃ, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyaṃ, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyyaṃ, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyā”ti?
segments.sn22.86:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā anurādho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā anurādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn22.86:4.3: Atha kho, bhante, sambahulā aññatitthiyā paribbājakā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu … pe … maṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn22.86:4.4: ‘yo so, āvuso anurādha, tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato imesu catūsu ṭhānesu paññāpayamāno paññāpeti –
segments.sn22.86:4.5: hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā, na hoti …
segments.sn22.86:4.6: hoti ca na ca hoti, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā’”ti?
segments.sn22.86:5.1: Evaṃ vuttāhaṃ, bhante, te aññatitthiye paribbājake etadavocaṃ –
segments.sn22.86:5.2: “yo so, āvuso, tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto, taṃ tathāgato aññatra imehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññāpeti –
segments.sn22.86:5.4: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vāti.
segments.sn22.86:5.5: Evaṃ vutte, bhante, te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā maṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn22.86:5.6: ‘so cāyaṃ bhikkhu na vo bhavissati acirapabbajito thero vā pana bālo abyatto’ti.
segments.sn22.86:5.7: Atha kho maṃ, bhante, te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā navavādena bālavādena ca apasādetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu”.
segments.sn22.86:6.1: “Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, acirapakkantesu tesu aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu etadahosi –
segments.sn22.86:6.2: ‘sace kho maṃ te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā uttariṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyuṃ.
segments.sn22.86:6.3: Kathaṃ byākaramāno nu khvāhaṃ tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ vuttavādī ceva bhagavato assaṃ, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyaṃ, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyyaṃ, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyā’”ti?
segments.sn22.86:7.4: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.86:7.6: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ –
segments.sn22.86:10.2: rūpaṃ … vedanā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ tathāgatoti samanupassasī”ti?
segments.sn22.86:11.2: ayaṃ so arūpī avedano asaññī asaṅkhāro aviññāṇo tathāgatoti samanupassasī”ti?
segments.sn22.86:12.1: “Ettha ca te, anurādha, diṭṭheva dhamme saccato thetato tathāgate anupalabbhiyamāne kallaṃ nu te taṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ –
segments.sn22.86:12.2: ‘yo so, āvuso, tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato aññatra imehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññāpeti –
segments.sn22.86:12.3: hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā … neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā’”ti?
segments.sn22.86:13.2: Pubbe cāhaṃ, anurādha, etarahi ca dukkhañceva paññapemi, dukkhassa ca nirodhan”ti.

lines: Taṃ tathāgatoti tumhākaṃ satthā tathāgato taṃ sattaṃ tathāgataṃ.
Aññatra imehīti tassa kira evaṃ ahosi “ime sāsanassa paṭipakkhā paṭivilomā, yathā ime bhaṇanti, na evaṃ satthā paññāpessati, aññathā paññāpessatī”ti.

Evaṃ vutte te aññatitthiyāti evaṃ therena attano ca paresañca samayaṃ ajānitvā vutte ekadesena sāsanasamayaṃ jānantā therassa vāde dosaṃ dātukāmā te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ etadavocuṃ.
Taṃ kiṃ maññasi anurādhāti satthā tassa kathaṃ sutvā cintesi –
“ayaṃ bhikkhu attano laddhiyaṃ dosaṃ na jānāti, kārako panesa yuttayogo, dhammadesanāya eva naṃ jānāpessāmī”ti tiparivaṭṭaṃ desanaṃ desetukāmo “taṃ kiṃ maññasi, anurādhā”tiādimāha.
Athassa tāya desanāya arahattappattassa anuyogavattaṃ āropento taṃ kiṃ maññasi, anurādha?
Dukkhañceva paññapemi, dukkhassa ca nirodhanti vaṭṭadukkhañceva vaṭṭadukkhassa ca nirodhaṃ nibbānaṃ paññapemi.
Tasmiṃ gahite samudayasaccaṃ gahitameva hoti, tassa mūlattā.
Tasmiṃ gahite maggasaccaṃ gahitameva hoti tassa upāyattā.
Iti pubbe cāhaṃ, anurādha, etarahi ca catusaccameva paññapemīti dasseti.
Tasseva vihārassāti mahāvane yasmiṃ vihāre bhagavā viharati, tasseva vihārassa.
Yasmā ayaṃ thero ṭhapanīyaṃ pañhaṃ ṭhapanīyabhāvena na ṭhapesi, tasmā.
Vaṭṭavivaṭṭamevāti pañcannaṃ pana khandhānaṃ samanupassanāya vasena vaṭṭaṃ,“evaṃ passan”tiādinā vivaṭṭaṃ kathitameva.
